why: Could not refute; all three checks positively confirm. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM. curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog.md (5258 lines, md5 a346d16e7ea073de689a2bcefdbbb3c3) carries the claimed string at line 20, under <Update label="2.1.219" description="July 24, 2026">. I byte-compared: cmp of the claimed string against `sed -n 20p | tr -d '\n'` is IDENTICAL including the two-space list indent, and od -c on the whole line ends '...mid-session \n' — a single-sentence bullet with nothing hiding after it, so the 'second sentence reverses the conclusion' trap does not apply. `changelog` is row 65 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv and row 73 of the coverage map, i.e. a checked Claude Code contract source under AGENTS.md, not an out-of-scope platform.claude.com page. (2) REPO STATE CONFIRMED. `grep -ran DirectoryAdded packages apps` -> 0 hits, run with -a so the NUL-byte files are covered (pi-agent.ts is confirmed one of them). Repo-wide the only hits are in docs/superpowers/specs/** — this sweep's own output. The cited block is real: format-adapters.ts:123-152 is CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP with exactly 28 entries and no DirectoryAdded; :99-102 is DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS with exactly two keys (MessageDisplay, TeammateIdle); :117-122 is the doc comment '28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events'; hooks-runtime.ts:25-55 is PluginHookEventName with 30 names (28 Claude + McpServerStart + McpToolCall), likewise omitting it. (3) CONSEQUENCE VERIFIED SEPARATELY FROM THE IDENTIFIER — nothing upstream absorbs it. mapExternalHookEventName (format-adapters.ts:622-646) resolves strictly dialect table -> DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS -> pluginDiagnostic('warning','plugin.format.unknown_hook_event'); I read the whole function and there is NO generic fallback arm. Its only 'claude' caller is format-adapters/claude.ts:1308, which at :1315 falls back to reasonCode 'plugin.deferred.claude_hook_event_unsupported' because mapped.deferredReasonCode is undefined. So the outcome is exactly what the code's own comments at :634-635 and :1312-1314 say they want to avoid. ONE LAYER UP — the emission site exists, so this is a real hole and not a vacuous one: pi-agent.ts:3193-3211 handles a session-scoped `addDirectories` grant from a PermissionRequest hook's updatedPermissions and does `applied.push({ type: 'addDirectories', root })`, which is precisely where a DirectoryAdded hook would fire. NOT AN OWNER DECISION: I read all nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3. Item 5 is the only hook-related one; it scopes 'do not revive' to the DEAD executor in hooks-runtime.ts (PluginHookRuntime / runHooks / parseHookOutput / createHookRegistryFromProjection) and explicitly preserves PluginHookEventName because three production files import it — it says nothing about the event roster. None of the other eight touch hooks. NOT A DELIBERATE PRODUCT DIFFERENCE: this is neither a Claude/ChatGPT subscription flow, nor gateway routing, nor de-branding. NO SIBLING-SUBSYSTEM MIXUP: CwdChanged is a distinct event on the same SDK table that we DO map (format-adapters.ts:143), and WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove are separate again; CODEX_HOOK_EVENT_MAP is a separate table that also omits it. DUPLICATE: this is the same single gap already challenged and survived as f000 (agent-sdk/hooks) and f079 (agent-sdk/typescript) — three Claude pages document it, so it is one fix with three citations, not three findings.
correctedState: Confirmed, with four precisions. (a) LINE DRIFT: the cited format-adapters.ts:122 is the closing '*/' of the doc comment. The load-bearing lines are :118 (the stale '28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events' count), :123-152 (CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP, 28 entries), :99-102 (DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS, 2 entries) and :622-646 (mapExternalHookEventName's no-fallback resolution order). (b) THE CONSEQUENCE IS OVERSTATED AS WRITTEN: an imported Claude plugin declaring DirectoryAdded does not get 'an unknown event instead of a deferral' — it gets BOTH a 'plugin.format.unknown_hook_event' warning (format-adapters.ts:638-644) AND a deferred report entry carrying the GENERIC reason 'plugin.deferred.claude_hook_event_unsupported' (format-adapters/claude.ts:1315). The defect is that the deferral is unrouted and is accompanied by a typo-flavoured warning, not that the hook is silently dropped. (c) 'ABSENT EVERYWHERE' is true of code only: grep -ran DirectoryAdded packages apps -> 0, but the string does appear in ten docs/superpowers/specs files, all this sweep's own output. (d) THE CHANGELOG IS NOT THE ONLY SOURCE, AND THE STALE COUNT IS SUBTLER THAN CLAIMED: DirectoryAdded also appears at agent-sdk/hooks.md:181 (roster table, Python 'No' / TypeScript 'Yes') and agent-sdk/typescript.md:1559 (the HookEvent union, 31 members). The main hooks.md reference (3173 lines) has ZERO hits and documents 30 events, so our '30 documented' count is CORRECT against hooks.md and stale only against the fuller roster of 31 — the plugin-hook reference itself has not caught up. Because the changelog says /add-dir fires it, it is a CLI-level event and not SDK-only. Minimum fix: one entry in DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS plus a refreshed count in the two comments (format-adapters.ts:118, hooks-runtime.ts:13); full support additionally needs a PluginHookEventName member, a CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP entry, and an emission point at pi-agent.ts:3211. Same gap as f000 and f079 — fix once.
